via_reroute_attempt: Disposable only; did not pass connectivity/DRC. Rejected and not promoted. Frozen valid R4 remains canonical.
purchasing_change: Owned insulated HOLD jumper replaces unselected0.20USD shunt; saves0.22USD with tax allowance.
why_not_cleared: Landed supplier charges are unbounded by current quotes.
Exact module revision and heatsink contents still require vendor confirmation.
Actual motor current/torque, soldering, power sequencing, cooling and regeneration require hardware qualification.
UART_fixes_implemented: Both configure_all and poll_drivers prepare ALL5 modules with write-only SENDDELAY2 before any read batch. This includes ARM/MOVE checks beforeCHECK and refreshes a node reset between batches.
read_register rejects requests before bootstrap and waits150us after accepted replies or failed timeout, then drains on failure.
The write-only SLAVECONF0x03 is written again after IFCNTbaseline; delta7 covers all7 configuration writes, including SENDDELAY. No nonexistent readback is invented.
Runtime uses shared UART baud/idle/send-delay constants and tested IFCNTwrap helper.
CSV_import_note: LCSC import CSV has no UTF8 BOM; all four CSV exports round-trip cell-for-cell through the spreadsheet library.
